name: MCP Sentinel Server
description: Registers MCP Sentinel Tool plugins with mcp_server and wires OAuth scopes.
project_description: MCP Sentinel Server is the submodule that bridges the MCP Sentinel governed Tool plugins to the MCP Server module. It depends on mcp_server's Tool API bridge (mcp_server_tool_bridge >= 2.0.0-beta3). It registers each Sentinel tool as an mcp_tool_config entity and tags every tool with the exact OAuth scope derived from the plugin itself (content read/write via mcp_read/mcp_write, config read/write via mcp_config_read/mcp_config), so scopes are never hand-declared. It also implements the bridge's discovery-access hook so catalog visibility runs through each governed tool's own readiness/scope/IP gate. It has no settings page and is operated entirely through Drush: mcp-sentinel:setup registers the tools with required OAuth by default (an explicit development-only escape stays not-ready and exits non-zero), mcp-sentinel:teardown unregisters them, and mcp-sentinel:agent-provision / agent-reconcile provision per-environment agent tiers (role + service account + designated OAuth Consumer) without creating any secrets.
